title: Distribution properties of generalized polynomials
summary: A generalized polynomial is a function defined by an iteration of the operations addition, multiplication and the floor function. Equidistribution results of sequences given by generalized polynomials have been established by Håland and later by Bergelson and Leibman from an ergodic theoretic point of view. In the present paper we show an asymptotic distribution result which can be applied to certain generalized polynomials. In the second part we prove equidistribution results for generalized polynomials along prime numbers, including bounds for the discrepancy.
